title.zh: 数列与求和 · 叠砖与棋盘麦粒
title.en: Sequences & Series · Stacked Bricks and Chessboard Grains

desc.zh: 叠砖每层多一块是等差，棋盘麦粒每格翻倍是等比；倒序相加当场拼出求和公式，等比求和则告诉你“无限多项”能不能有尽头。
desc.en: Bricks with one more per layer are arithmetic, grains that double per square are geometric; add a row backwards to build the sum formula on the spot, and see whether infinitely many terms can add up.

legacyLayout._note: Whitespace and markup of the hand-written lesson this page was converted from, so the conversion could be checked byte for byte (specs/site-template.md §3c).
